request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"The Gaming Guild is hosting a LAN Party, an overnight gaming event in a campus hall that is open to all students. We are reaching out because the students who come will be sharing a room full of games, and having loaner monitors would make a real difference to how many of them can comfortably play. Your help with monitors would mean more students can join in, stay engaged through the night, and enjoy a welcoming event together. We would be glad to tell you more about the event and answer any questions you have.","contains_instructions":false}
